title: Framework's 10G Ethernet module exposes USB-C's complexity
summary: Jeff Geerling analyzes Framework's new 10G Ethernet expansion module and explores the technical complexity behind USB-C connectors, including bandwidth limitations, protocol negotiation, and compatibility challenges when using USB-C for high-speed networking.
problem_solved: Explains why USB-C, despite its versatility, introduces complexity when used for demanding applications like 10Gbit Ethernet.
why_valuable: Provides hands-on technical insights into USB-C limitations, helping tech enthusiasts and developers understand real-world hardware constraints beyond marketing specs.
